device_selection_note: Protocol names CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0. Physical GPU 0 on this shared DGX-1 was occupied by another user's long-running job with ~2 GB free, insufficient for OLMoE FP16 (~14 GB). All eight GPUs are identical Tesla V100-SXM2-32GB, so the V100-only requirement holds. With user authorization a free V100 was pinned so torch sees it as its sole device cuda:0.
